items.title: Is Merck Stock Reaching A Valuation Ceiling At 6x Sales?
items.summary: The oncology franchise that still carries about half of Merck is decelerating while the stock trades near its high.

items.title: SMMT Rises on Akeso's Win in Phase III Biliary Tract Cancer Study
items.summary: Summit gains as positive HARMONi-GI1 data show ivonescimab's OS benefit in biliary tract cancer, expanding its potential beyond NSCLC.

items.title: Can Cost Cuts And 2030 Targets Really Save Pfizer Stock?
items.summary: The company now leads with a cost-savings total and a growth rate that does not begin until the end of the decade, which tells a holder far less about whether its medicines are winning.

items.title: Can Eli Lilly's Oncology Portfolio Drive Growth Beyond GLP-1 Drugs?
items.summary: LLY's oncology revenues rise 11% in the first half of 2026, as newer drugs gain traction and pipeline assets add growth opportunities.

items.title: Moderna’s $2B Convertible-Note Deal To Focus On Oncology Growth, Debt Repayment – But Retail Calls It A ‘Bull Trap’
items.summary: The biotech firm announced plans to raise $2 billion through convertible notes, which could be increased to $2.3 billion.

items.title: Moderna raises $2 billion in convertible notes for cancer vaccine
items.summary: The biotech company will sell notes due 2032, with an option to raise an additional $300 million, days after its stock hit a multi-year high

items.title: SLS, IBRX Eye Fresh Oncology Tailwind As Cathie Wood’s ARK Backs Personalized Cancer-Vaccine Future
items.summary: ARK sees a path toward custom cancer treatments for every patient, though current costs of $200,000-$300,000 remain a major hurdle.

items.title: Revolution Medicines Wins FDA Approval for Pancreatic Cancer Pill. What It Means for the Stock.
items.summary: Daraxonrasib, the pill touted by a former member of Congress and cancer patient as a ‘miracle drug,’ has been granted approval in patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
